title: Audit queries and provenance-gap detection
note: The interesting mutations are A2, A3 and A7: they do not break a chain, they make an INCOMPLETE chain read as complete. A hole in provenance is indistinguishable from a fabrication nobody noticed, so an auditor that cannot see holes is worse than none -- it produces confident reassurance.  A13 and A20 are the pair that matters most: A13 hides canonical authority resting on a withdrawn input, and A20 is the real defect that made that state unfixable -- the cascade cited a digest it never stored, so it could not run at all in the only configuration where citations are checked.

mutations.name: A1_audit_accepts_a_tampered_log
mutations.rationale: an audit produces a confident answer about a document that may have been rewritten -- worse than refusing

mutations.name: A2_missing_records_not_reported
mutations.rationale: a VERIFIED task with no evidence record reads as fully supported

mutations.name: A7_completeness_always_true
mutations.rationale: every chain reports as complete, including the ones with holes

mutations.name: A17_denials_can_be_asked_for_allows
mutations.rationale: denials() silently returns permissions when a caller passes allowed=True

mutations.name: A18_unpublished_policy_digest_accepted
mutations.rationale: a decision citing a policy digest nobody published -- the tampering signature -- joins clean

mutations.name: A19_decision_under_no_policy_accepted
mutations.rationale: a decision under a policy this log never published reports as fully explained

mutations.name: A20_invalidation_cites_unstored_bytes
mutations.rationale: THE REGRESSION. The cascade cites a digest it never stores, so against an evidence-backed store -- the governed configuration -- invalidation cannot run at all and a record whose foundation was withdrawn can never be marked STALE

mutations.name: Q6_metrics_are_not_derived_from_the_events
mutations.rationale: a metric and an explanation start telling different stories about the same bytes

mutations.name: Q7_the_sink_does_not_redact
mutations.rationale: a credential reaches a collector, which is the cost of being wrong about 'a secret should not be there to redact'

mutations.name: Q8_the_sink_accepts_something_that_cannot_be_written_to
mutations.rationale: emission fails as an AttributeError three frames from the caller

mutations.name: Q9_the_sink_drops_events
mutations.rationale: a partial copy in a collector is worse than none, because it looks complete

mutations.name: Q10_cross_task_tool_queries_match_everything
mutations.rationale: 'which tasks used this tool' answers with every task, which is a confident answer about the wrong thing
